rationale: With a unanimous merits vote grounded in text, history, and Cincinnati Soap/OPM v. Richmond, the Chief Justice is most likely to keep the opinion narrow and institutional, emphasizing that a capped, statute-based transfer is an "appropriation made by law" and rejecting any implied annuality requirement. Separate writings are most likely from Justices Thomas/Gorsuch (originalist/structural framing) and Alito/Barrett (remedy and Army-Clause negative-inference emphasis), but the Court’s shared remedial caution under Collins makes fragmentation modest.
